varietyReview: Eleven tasks include a polynomial bracket, output attainment, failed continuity, inconclusive same-sign endpoints, multiple roots from original exact table, a temperature context, interior subinterval construction, a logarithmic equation, uniqueness with an additional monotonicity hypothesis, graph intersections and endpoint-versus-interior targets.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
